envelopes.title: Shadow logistics matching before any field dispatch
envelopes.target_transition: verified interruption -> matched candidate supply with operator review
envelopes.diagnosis_hypothesis: Some verified interruptions are access/matching failures rather than true local scarcity.
envelopes.smallest_feasible_change: Generate non-binding shadow pickup/matching suggestions for operator review; do not dispatch automatically.
envelopes.expected_mechanism: Better matching of live compatible supply to verified demand can reduce avoidable access failures without adding new supply.
envelopes.rollback_plan: Stop recommendations and revert to existing operator workflow immediately.
safety_risks: unsafe food allocation if compatibility rules fail
integrity_risks: stale inventory could be mistaken for live capacity
envelopes.monitoring_plan: Compare shadow recommendations with operator decisions; if later piloted, monitor interruptions and safety incidents longitudinally.

gates.requirement: baseline/access hypothesis supported enough for a non-consequential shadow test
no allocation without reviewed compatibility constraints
shadow recommendations can be stopped without operational dependency
nutrition compatibility rules reviewed by qualified veterinarian
participating shelter/operator approval before any field pilot
gates.notes: Not needed for pure offline shadow evaluation; required for deployment.

envelopes.title: Reversible documentation support without eligibility automation
envelopes.diagnosis_hypothesis: A material share of abandonment is caused by avoidable documentation/information friction rather than service-capacity scarcity.
envelopes.smallest_feasible_change: Provide a bounded checklist/explanation assistant that cannot decide eligibility, deny access, or alter official requirements.
envelopes.expected_mechanism: Clearer requirement explanation can reduce avoidable incomplete submissions while preserving human eligibility decisions.
envelopes.rollback_plan: Disable the support surface and restore the existing information workflow.
safety_risks: incorrect guidance could create invalid submissions
envelopes.monitoring_plan: Track the targeted funnel transition plus incorrect submissions, staff burden and due-process guardrails before and after any bounded pilot.

gates.requirement: transition-level drop-off and sampled cause evidence
support cannot trigger denial or irreversible decision
requirements originate from approved source-of-truth content
preserve due process, appeal and equal access
service operator authorization before user-facing pilot
